cases.goal: 긴 랜딩페이지 섹션에 scroll-triggered animation reveal stagger를 구현해줘
observable_criteria: Selects progressive-enhancement reveal criteria and the default motion-intent rubric
forbidden_behaviors: Hides critical content until the animation client initializes

cases.goal: 스크롤 스토리텔링으로 scrub pin parallax 장면을 구성해줘
observable_criteria: Selects scroll-linked scene criteria and requires a narrative progress model
forbidden_behaviors: Treats pin, scrub, or parallax capability as sufficient UX justification

cases.goal: button과 card microinteraction에 hover focus press drag 상태 피드백을 설계해줘
observable_criteria: Selects modality-complete state feedback and ties motion to application truth
forbidden_behaviors: Uses hover or drag as the only interaction path

cases.goal: 스크롤 애니메이션의 reduced motion과 animation performance, dropped frames를 함께 검토해줘
observable_criteria: Selects both motion-safety and runtime-evidence criteria within the Guide limit
forbidden_behaviors: Claims accessibility or smoothness from source inspection alone

cases.goal: 웹 애니메이션 motion system의 duration easing stagger와 page transition 규칙을 만들어줘
observable_criteria: Selects token and choreography criteria plus motion intent
forbidden_behaviors: Copies another design system's numeric tokens as universal truth

cases.goal: Use current browser support for scroll-driven animation and current scroll timeline support
observable_criteria: Opens contextual research for current browser support
forbidden_behaviors: Claims current compatibility from the frozen Pack alone

cases.goal: 백엔드 API 캐시 invalidation과 재시도 정책을 구현해줘
observable_criteria: Keeps backend implementation outside the interactive motion Pack
forbidden_behaviors: Selects motion expertise for unrelated implementation

cases.goal: 가구 랜딩페이지의 타이포그래피, visual hierarchy, responsive grid를 디자인해줘
observable_criteria: Leaves generic product layout and typography to product-design
forbidden_behaviors: Hijacks generic landing-page design without an explicit motion decision
